6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyZarMapAlg
7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyVehicle

9	/-!
10	# The locally certified divisor functor on all test objects: the vehicle (DD-2 stage S6a)
11	
12	The Addendum-2 divisor-functor value on an affine test is `DivFamZar C R π n`
13	(`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyZar`), with base change `DivFamZar.mapAlg`
14	along arbitrary test changes (`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyZarMapAlg`).
15	This file extends it to **all** of `Over (Spec k)` by the bespoke affine-opens limit,
16	mirroring the globally certified vehicle `AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyVehicle`
17	clause for clause:
18	
19	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFamZar.mapAlgHom`: base change of locally certified divisor
20	  classes along an **explicit** `k`-algebra map — `DivFamZar.mapAlg` at the induced
21	  algebra tower, with the functor laws `DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_id`/`DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_comp`
22	  from the S5b laws `DivFamZar.mapAlg_id`/`DivFamZar.mapAlg_comp`.
23	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_eq_mapAlg`: **the face-change bridge** — along
24	  an algebra map agreeing with a scalar-tower structure map, the explicit face is the
25	  instance face (`DivFamZar.mapAlg_congr`, algebra structures with equal structure maps
26	  are equal).  This is how the S6 general-test statements consume the S5b keystones
27	  `DivFamZar.eq_of_away_eq`/`DivFamZar.exists_glue_of_away_compat`, which are spelled in
28	  the instance face.
29	* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivFamZar.congr`: transport along an isomorphism of test algebras.
30	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divFamZar C π n T`: **the vehicle** — compatible families of
31	  locally certified divisor classes over the affine opens of `T.left`, with
32	  `divFamZar.eval` the evaluation at an affine open.
33	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divFamZarAffineEquiv C π n R`: **the affine comparison** — on an
34	  affine test `overSpec k R` the vehicle collapses by evaluation at the top affine open
35	  to `DivFamZar C R π n` (the `divFamAffineEquiv` template, clause for clause).
36	* `AlgebraicGeometry.divFam.toZarVehicle`: **the comparison from the globally certified
37	  vehicle** — componentwise `DivFam.toZar`, compatible by `DivFam.toZar_mapAlg`
38	  (packaged on the explicit face as `DivFam.toZar_mapAlgHom`); it intertwines the two
39	  affine comparisons (`divFamZarAffineEquiv_toZarVehicle`).
40	
41	Functoriality in `T` along an *arbitrary* morphism of test objects (glued values over
42	basic-open refinements, the `picEtMap` pattern) is
43	`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyZarMap`; the sheaf statements at arbitrary tests
44	are `AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyZarSheaf`.
45	
46	The `k`-algebra structure on section rings is `Over.sectionsAlgebra` and the algebra
47	structures on the relative curve's section rings are `Scheme.overModule`/
48	`Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra` (LOCAL instances, house rule) — consumers must activate
49	the same instances.
50	-/
51	
52	set_option autoImplicit false
53	/- Statements mix the section rings `Γ(T.left, ·)` with the locally certified
54	divisor-functor values over them, which are stated on the product spelling
55	`(C ⊗ overSpec k R).left`; see `AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.RelativeSectionsLinear`. -/
56	set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
57	/- `lake env lean` drops the lakefile's `[leanOptions]` (I-0161), so the pinned synthesis
58	depth must be set in-file for the faithful per-file check. -/
59	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
60	
61	universe u
62	
63	open CategoryTheory
64	
65	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
66	
67	attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra Scheme.overModule Scheme.overSectionsAlgebra
68	
69	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
70	variable {π : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsAffineHom π] {n : ℕ}
71	
72	noncomputable section
73	
74	/-! ## Base change of locally certified classes along an explicit algebra map
75	
76	`DivFamZar.mapAlg` (`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyZarMapAlg`) is parameterized
77	by an algebra-tower instance pack `[Algebra R R'] [IsScalarTower k R R']`.  The vehicle
78	indexes its compatibilities by the section-restriction maps `Over.resAlgHom`, so it
79	consumes the explicit-map face — the `DivFam.mapAlgHom` packaging of
80	`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyVehicle`, verbatim. -/
81	
82	namespace DivFamZar
83	
84	variable {A A' A'' : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [CommRing A'] [Algebra k A']
85	  [CommRing A''] [Algebra k A'']
86	
87	/-- Base change of locally certified divisor classes along an explicit `k`-algebra map
88	of affine tests: `DivFamZar.mapAlg` at the algebra structure `RingHom.toAlgebra` of the
89	map.  The instance-parameterized `DivFamZar.mapAlg` remains the preferred form whenever
90	a scalar tower is already in scope. -/
91	def mapAlgHom (φ : A →ₐ[k] A') : DivFamZar C A π n → DivFamZar C A' π n :=
92	  letI : Algebra A A' := φ.toRingHom.toAlgebra
93	  haveI : IsScalarTower k A A' := .of_algebraMap_eq fun a => (φ.commutes a).symm
94	  DivFamZar.mapAlg A' n
95	
96	/-- `mapAlgHom` along the identity is the identity (`DivFamZar.mapAlg_id`). -/
97	theorem mapAlgHom_id (F : DivFamZar C A π n) : mapAlgHom (AlgHom.id k A) F = F :=
98	  DivFamZar.mapAlg_id n F
99	
100	/-- `mapAlgHom` along a composite is the composite of the base changes
101	(`DivFamZar.mapAlg_comp`). -/
102	theorem mapAlgHom_comp (φ : A →ₐ[k] A') (ψ : A' →ₐ[k] A'') (F : DivFamZar C A π n) :
103	    mapAlgHom (ψ.comp φ) F = mapAlgHom ψ (mapAlgHom φ F) :=
104	  letI : Algebra A A' := φ.toRingHom.toAlgebra
105	  haveI : IsScalarTower k A A' := .of_algebraMap_eq fun x => (φ.commutes x).symm
106	  letI : Algebra A' A'' := ψ.toRingHom.toAlgebra
107	  haveI : IsScalarTower k A' A'' := .of_algebraMap_eq fun x => (ψ.commutes x).symm
108	  letI : Algebra A A'' := (ψ.comp φ).toRingHom.toAlgebra
109	  haveI : IsScalarTower k A A'' := .of_algebraMap_eq fun x => ((ψ.comp φ).commutes x).symm
110	  haveI : IsScalarTower A A' A'' := .of_algebraMap_eq fun _ => rfl
111	  (DivFamZar.mapAlg_comp A' n A'' F).symm
112	
113	/-! ### The face-change bridge -/
114	
115	/-- `DivFamZar.mapAlg` depends on the `A`-algebra structure of the target only through
116	the structure itself: equal algebra structures give equal base changes (the scalar-tower
117	witnesses are proof-irrelevant).  The congruence backing the face-change bridge
118	`mapAlgHom_eq_mapAlg`. -/
119	theorem mapAlg_congr {a₁ a₂ : Algebra A A'} (h : a₁ = a₂)
120	    (t₁ : @IsScalarTower k A A' Algebra.toSMul a₁.toSMul Algebra.toSMul)
121	    (t₂ : @IsScalarTower k A A' Algebra.toSMul a₂.toSMul Algebra.toSMul)
122	    (F : DivFamZar C A π n) :
123	    @DivFamZar.mapAlg k _ C A _ _ π _ A' _ _ a₁ t₁ n F
124	      = @DivFamZar.mapAlg k _ C A _ _ π _ A' _ _ a₂ t₂ n F := by
125	  subst h
126	  rfl
127	
128	/-- **The face-change bridge**: `mapAlgHom` along an algebra map that agrees with the
129	structure map of a scalar tower in scope is the instance-based `DivFamZar.mapAlg` of the
130	tower.  This is how the vehicle statements (spelled at `Over.resAlgHom`) consume the S5b
131	Zariski keystones (spelled at localization instance packs). -/
132	theorem mapAlgHom_eq_mapAlg [Algebra A A'] [IsScalarTower k A A'] (φ : A →ₐ[k] A')
133	    (hφ : ∀ a, φ a = algebraMap A A' a) (F : DivFamZar C A π n) :
134	    mapAlgHom φ F = DivFamZar.mapAlg A' n F := by
135	  unfold mapAlgHom
136	  exact mapAlg_congr (Algebra.algebra_ext _ _ hφ) _ _ F
137	
138	/-! ### Transport along an isomorphism of test algebras -/
139	
140	/-- Transport of locally certified divisor classes along an isomorphism of test
141	algebras. -/
142	def congr (e : A ≃ₐ[k] A') : DivFamZar C A π n ≃ DivFamZar C A' π n where
143	  toFun := mapAlgHom e.toAlgHom
144	  invFun := mapAlgHom e.symm.toAlgHom
145	  left_inv F := by
146	    rw [← mapAlgHom_comp, show e.symm.toAlgHom.comp e.toAlgHom = AlgHom.id k A from
147	      AlgHom.ext fun a => e.symm_apply_apply a, mapAlgHom_id]
148	  right_inv F := by
149	    rw [← mapAlgHom_comp, show e.toAlgHom.comp e.symm.toAlgHom = AlgHom.id k A' from
150	      AlgHom.ext fun a => e.apply_symm_apply a, mapAlgHom_id]
151	
152	/-- The transport along an isomorphism is `mapAlgHom` of its underlying map. -/
153	@[simp]
154	lemma congr_apply (e : A ≃ₐ[k] A') (F : DivFamZar C A π n) :
155	    congr e F = mapAlgHom e.toAlgHom F :=
156	  rfl
157	
158	/-- The inverse transport along an isomorphism is `mapAlgHom` of the inverse map. -/
159	@[simp]
160	lemma congr_symm_apply (e : A ≃ₐ[k] A') (F : DivFamZar C A' π n) :
161	    (congr e).symm F = mapAlgHom e.symm.toAlgHom F :=
162	  rfl
163	
164	end DivFamZar
165	
166	/-- **`toZar` intertwines the explicit-face base changes**: the comparison from
167	globally certified to locally certified classes is natural in the test algebra along an
168	explicit `k`-algebra map — `DivFam.toZar_mapAlg` at the induced tower. -/
169	lemma DivFam.toZar_mapAlgHom {A A' : Type u} [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] [CommRing A']
170	    [Algebra k A'] (φ : A →ₐ[k] A') (F : DivFam C A π n) :
171	    (DivFam.mapAlgHom φ F).toZar = DivFamZar.mapAlgHom φ F.toZar :=
172	  letI : Algebra A A' := φ.toRingHom.toAlgebra
173	  haveI : IsScalarTower k A A' := .of_algebraMap_eq fun a => (φ.commutes a).symm
174	  DivFam.toZar_mapAlg A' n F
175	
176	/-! ## The affine-opens limit -/
177	
178	variable (C π n)
179	
180	/-- **The locally certified divisor functor at an arbitrary test object**
181	(`informal/spec-dd-2.md` §6 on the Addendum-2 carrier; the `divFam` vehicle):
182	compatible families of locally certified divisor classes over the affine opens of
183	`T.left` — the value at a smaller affine open is the base change of the value at a
184	larger one along the section-restriction algebra map.  On affine tests this is
185	`DivFamZar` itself (`divFamZarAffineEquiv`); on general tests it is its canonical
186	Zariski-continuous extension. -/
187	def divFamZar (T : Over (Spec (.of k))) : Type u :=
188	  {s : Π U : T.left.affineOpens, DivFamZar C Γ(T.left, U.1) π n //
189	    ∀ (U V : T.left.affineOpens) (h : U.1 ≤ V.1),
190	      DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (Over.resAlgHom T h) (s V) = s U}
191	
192	namespace divFamZar
193	
194	variable {C π n} {T : Over (Spec (.of k))}
195	
196	/-- The compatibility of a section of `divFamZar` along an inclusion of affine opens. -/
197	lemma compat (s : divFamZar C π n T) (U V : T.left.affineOpens) (h : U.1 ≤ V.1) :
198	    DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (Over.resAlgHom T h) (s.1 V) = s.1 U :=
199	  s.2 U V h
200	
201	/-- Two sections of `divFamZar` agreeing at every affine open are equal. -/
202	@[ext]
203	lemma ext {s t : divFamZar C π n T} (h : ∀ U : T.left.affineOpens, s.1 U = t.1 U) :
204	    s = t :=
205	  Subtype.ext (funext h)
206	
207	variable (C π n T) in
208	/-- Evaluation of a section of `divFamZar` at an affine open. -/
209	def eval (U : T.left.affineOpens) : divFamZar C π n T → DivFamZar C Γ(T.left, U.1) π n :=
210	  fun s => s.1 U
211	
212	/-- Evaluation is projection to the component at the affine open. -/
213	@[simp]
214	lemma eval_apply (U : T.left.affineOpens) (s : divFamZar C π n T) :
215	    eval C π n T U s = s.1 U :=
216	  rfl
217	
218	end divFamZar
219	
220	/-! ## The affine comparison -/
221	
222	section Affine
223	
224	variable (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [Algebra k R]
225	
226	/-- Evaluation at the top affine open of an affine test, composed with the
227	`ΓSpecIso`-transport into the test algebra: the forward direction of the affine
228	comparison. -/
229	def divFamZarToAff : divFamZar C π n (overSpec k R) → DivFamZar C R π n :=
230	  fun s => DivFamZar.congr (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R) (s.1 (overSpecTopAffine R))
231	
232	/-- The section of `divFamZar` over an affine test determined by a locally certified
233	divisor class of the test algebra: restrict from the top affine open — the inverse
234	direction of the affine comparison. -/
235	def divFamZarOfAff : DivFamZar C R π n → divFamZar C π n (overSpec k R) :=
236	  fun x =>
237	    ⟨fun U => DivFamZar.mapAlgHom
238	      ((Over.resAlgHom (overSpec k R) le_top).comp
239	        (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).symm.toAlgHom) x,
240	      fun U V h => by rw [← DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_comp, ← AlgHom.comp_assoc,
241	        Over.resAlgHom_comp]⟩
242	
243	/-- The value of `divFamZarOfAff` at every affine open is the restricted transported
244	class. -/
245	lemma divFamZarOfAff_val (x : DivFamZar C R π n) (U : (overSpec k R).left.affineOpens) :
246	    (divFamZarOfAff C π n R x).1 U
247	      = DivFamZar.mapAlgHom
248	          ((Over.resAlgHom (overSpec k R) le_top).comp
249	            (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).symm.toAlgHom) x :=
250	  rfl
251	
252	/-- Round trip on the vehicle side: restricting the transported top value recovers every
253	component, by the compatibility of the section. -/
254	private lemma divFamZarOfAff_divFamZarToAff (s : divFamZar C π n (overSpec k R)) :
255	    divFamZarOfAff C π n R (divFamZarToAff C π n R s) = s := by
256	  refine divFamZar.ext fun U => ?_
257	  calc (divFamZarOfAff C π n R (divFamZarToAff C π n R s)).1 U
258	      = DivFamZar.mapAlgHom
259	          (((Over.resAlgHom (overSpec k R) le_top).comp
260	              (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).symm.toAlgHom).comp
261	            (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).toAlgHom)
262	          (s.1 (overSpecTopAffine R)) :=
263	        (DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_comp _ _ _).symm
264	    _ = DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (Over.resAlgHom (overSpec k R) le_top)
265	          (s.1 (overSpecTopAffine R)) := by
266	        rw [AlgHom.comp_assoc,
267	          show (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).symm.toAlgHom.comp
268	              (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).toAlgHom
269	            = AlgHom.id k Γ((overSpec k R).left, ⊤) from
270	            AlgHom.ext fun a => (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).symm_apply_apply a,
271	          AlgHom.comp_id]
272	    _ = s.1 U := s.compat U (overSpecTopAffine R) le_top
273	
274	/-- Round trip on the algebra side: the two `ΓSpecIso` transports and the trivial
275	restriction collapse to the identity (`DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_id`). -/
276	private lemma divFamZarToAff_divFamZarOfAff (x : DivFamZar C R π n) :
277	    divFamZarToAff C π n R (divFamZarOfAff C π n R x) = x := by
278	  calc divFamZarToAff C π n R (divFamZarOfAff C π n R x)
279	      = DivFamZar.mapAlgHom
280	          ((Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).toAlgHom.comp
281	            ((Over.resAlgHom (overSpec k R) le_top).comp
282	              (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).symm.toAlgHom)) x :=
283	        (DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_comp _ _ _).symm
284	    _ = DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (AlgHom.id k R) x := by
285	        rw [show Over.resAlgHom (overSpec k R) (le_top :
286	              (⊤ : (overSpec k R).left.Opens) ≤ (⊤ : (overSpec k R).left.Opens))
287	            = AlgHom.id k Γ((overSpec k R).left, ⊤) from Over.resAlgHom_rfl _ le_top,
288	          AlgHom.id_comp,
289	          show (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).toAlgHom.comp
290	              (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).symm.toAlgHom
291	            = AlgHom.id k R from
292	            AlgHom.ext fun a => (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).apply_symm_apply a]
293	    _ = x := DivFamZar.mapAlgHom_id x
294	
295	/-- **The affine comparison equivalence** (`informal/spec-dd-2.md` §6, Addendum 2): on
296	an affine test `overSpec k R`, the affine-opens limit `divFamZar` collapses by
297	evaluation at the terminal element `⊤` of the affine-opens poset to the locally
298	certified divisor-functor value `DivFamZar C R π n` of the test algebra (the
299	`divFamAffineEquiv` template). -/
300	def divFamZarAffineEquiv : divFamZar C π n (overSpec k R) ≃ DivFamZar C R π n where
301	  toFun := divFamZarToAff C π n R
302	  invFun := divFamZarOfAff C π n R
303	  left_inv := divFamZarOfAff_divFamZarToAff C π n R
304	  right_inv := divFamZarToAff_divFamZarOfAff C π n R
305	
306	/-- The affine comparison evaluates at the top affine open and transports along
307	`Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv`. -/
308	@[simp]
309	lemma divFamZarAffineEquiv_apply (s : divFamZar C π n (overSpec k R)) :
310	    divFamZarAffineEquiv C π n R s
311	      = DivFamZar.mapAlgHom (Over.overSpecΓTopAlgEquiv k R).toAlgHom
312	          (s.1 (overSpecTopAffine R)) :=
313	  rfl
314	
315	/-- The inverse affine comparison restricts the transported class from the top affine
316	open. -/
317	@[simp]
318	lemma divFamZarAffineEquiv_symm_apply_val (x : DivFamZar C R π n)
319	    (U : (overSpec k R).left.affineOpens) :
320	    ((divFamZarAffineEquiv C π n R).symm x).1 U

9	/-!
10	# Conditional final packaging of divisor representability
11	
12	DDR-9.F7 has two logically separate parts: lifting the affine equivalences to arbitrary
13	tests, and packaging the resulting natural equivalences as a `RepresentableBy` datum.
14	This file formalizes the second part.  `DivRepGlobalData` records the general-test
15	pullback, classification map, inverse laws, and naturality.  Its `representableBy`
16	constructor is the final categorical packaging.
17	
18	The affine-to-general lift is intentionally not assumed to exist implicitly: a caller
19	must provide every field of `DivRepGlobalData`.
20	-/

23	set_option quotPrecheck false

37	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))}
38	variable {pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k} [IsFinite pi]
39	
40	noncomputable local instance instOverCleftDivRepKit :
41	    C.left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := ⟨C.hom⟩
42	
43	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
44	  [IsIntegral C.left]
45	  [LocallyOfFiniteType (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
46	  [QuasiCompact (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))]
47	  [IsDominant pi]
48	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
49	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
50	variable [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 0)]
51	  [Module.Finite k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1)]
52	variable (hpi : pi ≫ P1.structureMap k = C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
53	variable (g r1 r2 : ℕ)
54	variable (b1 : Module.Basis (Fin r1) k
55	  ↥(divisorSections k (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤))
56	variable (b2 : Module.Basis (Fin r2) k
57	  ↥(divisorSections k
58	    ((windowM_choice pi hpi g + windowS_choice pi hpi g) • fiberWeilDivisor pi) ⊤))
59	
60	local notation "DivOver" =>
61	  divSchemeOver k (windowS_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi)
62	    (windowM_choice pi hpi g • fiberWeilDivisor pi) g r1 r2 b1
63	    (b2.map (windowShiftEquiv hpi g).symm)
64	
65	/-- The exact general-test data needed for the final F7 packaging.  In the intended
66	construction, `pull` is assembled from the affine forward maps and `classify` by
67	gluing the affine backward classifiers. -/
68	structure DivRepGlobalData where
69	  pull : ∀ {T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))},
70	    (T ⟶ DivOver) → divFamZar C pi g T
71	  classify : ∀ {T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))},
72	    divFamZar C pi g T → (T ⟶ DivOver)
73	  classify_pull : ∀ {T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} (v : T ⟶ DivOver),
74	    classify (pull v) = v
75	  pull_classify : ∀ {T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} (F : divFamZar C pi g T),
76	    pull (classify F) = F
77	  pull_comp : ∀ {T T' : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} (f : T' ⟶ T)
78	    (v : T ⟶ DivOver),
79	    pull (f ≫ v) = divFamZar.map C pi g f (pull v)
80	
81	namespace DivRepGlobalData
82	
83	/-- The general-test equivalence underlying the represented functor. -/
84	noncomputable def equiv
85	    (D : DivRepGlobalData hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2)
86	    (T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) :
87	    (T ⟶ DivOver) ≃ divFamZar C pi g T where
88	  toFun := D.pull
89	  invFun := D.classify
90	  left_inv := D.classify_pull
91	  right_inv := D.pull_classify
92	
93	set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
94	@[simp]
95	theorem equiv_apply
96	    (D : DivRepGlobalData hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2)
97	    {T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} (v : T ⟶ DivOver) :
98	    equiv (hpi := hpi) (g := g) (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) D T v
99	      = D.pull v :=
100	  rfl
101	
102	set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
103	@[simp]
104	theorem equiv_symm_apply
105	    (D : DivRepGlobalData hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2)
106	    {T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} (F : divFamZar C pi g T) :
107	    (equiv (hpi := hpi) (g := g) (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) D T).symm F
108	      = D.classify F :=
109	  rfl
110	
111	/-- The final F7 categorical packaging: natural general-test pullback equivalences
112	represent the locally certified divisor functor by `DivScheme`. -/
113	noncomputable def representableBy
114	    (D : DivRepGlobalData hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2) :
115	    (divFunctor C pi g).RepresentableBy DivOver where
116	  homEquiv {T} :=
117	    equiv (hpi := hpi) (g := g) (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1) (b2 := b2) D T
118	  homEquiv_comp {T T'} f v := by
119	    change D.pull (f ≫ v) = divFamZar.map C pi g f (D.pull v)
120	    exact D.pull_comp f v
121	
122	set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
123	@[simp]
124	theorem representableBy_homEquiv_apply
125	    (D : DivRepGlobalData hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2)
126	    {T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} (v : T ⟶ DivOver) :
127	    (representableBy (hpi := hpi) (g := g) (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1)
128	      (b2 := b2) D).homEquiv v = D.pull v :=
129	  rfl
130	
131	set_option linter.unusedSectionVars false in
132	@[simp]
133	theorem representableBy_homEquiv_symm_apply
134	    (D : DivRepGlobalData hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2)
135	    {T : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} (F : divFamZar C pi g T) :
136	    (representableBy (hpi := hpi) (g := g) (r1 := r1) (r2 := r2) (b1 := b1)
137	      (b2 := b2) D).homEquiv.symm F = D.classify F :=
138	  rfl
139	
140	end DivRepGlobalData

142	end Curve

8	/-!
9	# `DivScheme g = Z(♦)`: the carve locus as a closed subscheme of the Grassmannian pair (DDR-1)
10	
11	The glued carve locus of the DAT-D design (`informal/spec-dd-r.md` §3 item 1): the
12	chart-wise loci `Z(♦) ⊆ Spec (R^I ⊗ R^J)` (`Picard/DivCarveLocus.lean`) assemble into a
13	closed subscheme of `grPair` through the mathlib ideal-sheaf machinery — `carveIdealSheaf`
14	is the kernel ideal sheaf of the disjoint family of chart loci (the largest ideal sheaf
15	vanishing on all of them, `⨅ over the pair atlas`), and `DivScheme` is its subscheme.
16	
17	* `AlgebraicGeometry.carveIdealSheaf`: the ideal sheaf `I_♦` on `grPair`.
18	* `AlgebraicGeometry.carveScheme`, `carveSchemeι`, `carveSchemeOver`: the generic glued
19	  locus, its closed immersion (mathlib's `IdealSheafData.subschemeι` instance), and its
20	  `Over (Spec k)` form.
21	* `AlgebraicGeometry.carveScheme_exists_factor_of_le_ker` and
22	  `carveIdealSheaf_le_ker_of_factors`: the factoring criterion at chart tests — a test
23	  map through a pair chart killing the chart carve ideal factors (uniquely, by `Mono`)
24	  through `carveSchemeι`.
25	* `AlgebraicGeometry.carveScheme_hom_ext` (`divScheme_hom_ext`, DDR-7's tail): morphisms
26	  into the locus are determined by their composites with the closed immersion.
27	* **Campaign spellings**: `DivScheme`, `divSchemeι`, `divSchemeOver` at the DAT-D
28	  windows.
29	
30	The chart-value identification (`carveIdealSheaf.ideal (pair chart) = I_♦`-chart, the
31	`KeyChart` of the DD-R roadmap) rests on the landed gluing compatibility
32	(`carveIdeal_le_ker_of_specMap_pairChartMap_eq`); its remaining half is the app-level
33	localization bookkeeping and is left to the successor lane (see the inbox memory).
34	-/

48	variable (k : Type u) [Field k] (g r₁ r₂ : ℕ)
49	variable {ι : Type u} (μ : ι → ((Fin r₁ → k) →ₗ[k] (Fin r₂ → k)))
50	
51	/-- **The carve ideal sheaf `I_♦`** on the Grassmannian pair: the largest ideal sheaf
52	vanishing on every chart-wise carve locus — the infimum of the kernels of the chart
53	loci mapped into `grPair`. -/
54	noncomputable def carveIdealSheaf : (grPair k g r₁ g r₂).IdealSheafData :=
55	  ⨅ c : (glueData k g r₁).J × (glueData k g r₂).J,
56	    (carveLocusToGrPair k g r₁ r₂ μ c.1 c.2).ker
57	
58	/-- **The glued carve locus `Z(♦)`** as a scheme: the subscheme of the carve ideal
59	sheaf on the Grassmannian pair. -/
60	noncomputable def carveScheme : Scheme :=
61	  (carveIdealSheaf k g r₁ r₂ μ).subscheme
62	
63	/-- **The closed immersion `Z(♦) ⟶ grPair`**. -/
64	noncomputable def carveSchemeι : carveScheme k g r₁ r₂ μ ⟶ grPair k g r₁ g r₂ :=
65	  (carveIdealSheaf k g r₁ r₂ μ).subschemeι
66	
67	instance isClosedImmersion_carveSchemeι :
68	    IsClosedImmersion (carveSchemeι k g r₁ r₂ μ) :=
69	  inferInstanceAs (IsClosedImmersion (carveIdealSheaf k g r₁ r₂ μ).subschemeι)
70	
71	/-- The kernel of the closed immersion is the carve ideal sheaf. -/
72	theorem ker_carveSchemeι :
73	    (carveSchemeι k g r₁ r₂ μ).ker = carveIdealSheaf k g r₁ r₂ μ :=
74	  Scheme.IdealSheafData.ker_subschemeι _
75	
76	/-- **`Z(♦)` as a test object of `Over (Spec k)`**. -/
77	noncomputable def carveSchemeOver : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
78	  Over.mk (carveSchemeι k g r₁ r₂ μ ≫ grPairStructMap k g r₁ g r₂)
79	
80	/-- Each chart-wise carve locus maps to the glued locus over `grPair`. -/
81	theorem carveIdealSheaf_le_ker_carveLocusToGrPair
82	    (i : (glueData k g r₁).J) (j : (glueData k g r₂).J) :
83	    carveIdealSheaf k g r₁ r₂ μ ≤ (carveLocusToGrPair k g r₁ r₂ μ i j).ker :=
84	  iInf_le _ (i, j)
85	
86	/-- **The factoring criterion, existence half** (the chart-test universal property): a
87	test morphism through a pair chart whose chart map kills the chart carve ideal factors
88	through the closed immersion `carveSchemeι`. -/
89	theorem carveScheme_exists_factor_of_le_ker
90	    (i : (glueData k g r₁).J) (j : (glueData k g r₂).J)
91	    {S : Type u} [CommRing S]
92	    (w : PairChartRing k g r₁ g r₂ i j →+* S)
93	    (hker : carveIdeal k g r₁ r₂ μ i j ≤ RingHom.ker w) :
94	    ∃ v : Spec (CommRingCat.of S) ⟶ carveScheme k g r₁ r₂ μ,
95	      v ≫ carveSchemeι k g r₁ r₂ μ
96	        = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom w) ≫ pairChartMap k g r₁ g r₂ i j := by
97	  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, -⟩ := (ideal_le_ker_iff_factors _ w).mp hker
98	  have hfac : Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom w) ≫ pairChartMap k g r₁ g r₂ i j
99	      = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom φ) ≫ carveLocusToGrPair k g r₁ r₂ μ i j := by
100	    rw [carveLocusToGrPair, carveLocusι]
101	    refine Eq.trans ?_ (Category.assoc _ _ _)
102	    refine congrArg (· ≫ pairChartMap k g r₁ g r₂ i j) ?_
103	    rw [← Spec.map_comp]
104	    exact (congrArg (fun ρ => Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom ρ)) hφ).symm
105	  refine ⟨IsClosedImmersion.lift (carveSchemeι k g r₁ r₂ μ)
106	    (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom w) ≫ pairChartMap k g r₁ g r₂ i j) ?_,
107	    IsClosedImmersion.lift_fac _ _ _⟩
108	  rw [ker_carveSchemeι, hfac]
109	  exact le_trans (carveIdealSheaf_le_ker_carveLocusToGrPair k g r₁ r₂ μ i j)
110	    (Scheme.Hom.le_ker_comp _ _)

113	closed immersion has the carve ideal sheaf in its kernel. -/
114	theorem carveIdealSheaf_le_ker_of_factors {T : Scheme.{u}} (u : T ⟶ grPair k g r₁ g r₂)
115	    (v : T ⟶ carveScheme k g r₁ r₂ μ) (hv : v ≫ carveSchemeι k g r₁ r₂ μ = u) :

118	  exact Scheme.Hom.le_ker_comp _ _

125	  (cancel_mono (carveSchemeι k g r₁ r₂ μ)).mp h

65	private lemma res_res {W V U : X.Opens} (h₁ : W ≤ V) (h₂ : V ≤ U) (s : Γ(X, U)) :
66	    (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h₁).op).hom ((X.presheaf.map (homOfLE h₂).op).hom s)
67	      = (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (h₁.trans h₂)).op).hom s := by
68	  rw [← CommRingCat.comp_apply, ← Functor.map_comp, ← op_comp, homOfLE_comp]

70	/-- **Divisor equality** of two local-equation systems: on a common refinement of the
71	two covers, the equations agree up to a unit at every point — common refinement plus
72	unit rescaling in a single move (the `CechPic`-pattern setoid of the DD-1 spec). -/
73	def DivEq (d₁ d₂ : X.LocalEquations) : Prop :=
74	  ∃ (𝒲 : X.PointedCover) (h₁ : 𝒲 ≤ d₁.cover) (h₂ : 𝒲 ≤ d₂.cover),
75	    ∀ x : X, ∃ u : Γ(X, 𝒲.opens x)ˣ,
76	      (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (h₁ x)).op).hom (d₁.eqn x)
77	        = (u : Γ(X, 𝒲.opens x))
78	          * (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (h₂ x)).op).hom (d₂.eqn x)
79	
80	lemma divEq_refl (d : X.LocalEquations) : DivEq d d :=
81	  ⟨d.cover, le_rfl, le_rfl, fun _ => ⟨1, by rw [Units.val_one, one_mul]⟩⟩
82	
83	lemma DivEq.symm {d₁ d₂ : X.LocalEquations} (h : DivEq d₁ d₂) : DivEq d₂ d₁ := by
84	  obtain ⟨𝒲, h₁, h₂, H⟩ := h
85	  refine ⟨𝒲, h₂, h₁, fun x => ?_⟩
86	  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := H x
87	  exact ⟨u⁻¹, by
88	    rw [hu, ← mul_assoc, ← Units.val_mul, inv_mul_cancel, Units.val_one, one_mul]⟩
89	
90	lemma DivEq.trans {d₁ d₂ d₃ : X.LocalEquations} (h : DivEq d₁ d₂) (h' : DivEq d₂ d₃) :
91	    DivEq d₁ d₃ := by
92	  obtain ⟨𝒲, h₁, h₂, H⟩ := h
93	  obtain ⟨𝒱, k₂, k₃, K⟩ := h'
94	  refine ⟨𝒲 ⊓ 𝒱, fun x => (inf_le_left (b := 𝒱.opens x)).trans (h₁ x),
95	    fun x => (inf_le_right (a := 𝒲.opens x)).trans (k₃ x), fun x => ?_⟩
96	  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := H x
97	  obtain ⟨v, hv⟩ := K x
98	  have E1 := congrArg (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE
99	    (inf_le_left : 𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒱.opens x ≤ 𝒲.opens x)).op).hom hu
100	  rw [map_mul, res_res, res_res] at E1
101	  have E2 := congrArg (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE
102	    (inf_le_right : 𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒱.opens x ≤ 𝒱.opens x)).op).hom hv
103	  rw [map_mul, res_res, res_res] at E2
104	  refine ⟨X.unitsRestrict inf_le_left u * X.unitsRestrict inf_le_right v, ?_⟩
105	  have hcast : ∀ (w : Γ(X, 𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒱.opens x)ˣ), (w : Γ(X, 𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒱.opens x))
106	      = w.val := fun _ => rfl
107	  rw [Units.val_mul]
108	  calc (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE _).op).hom (d₁.eqn x)
109	      = (X.unitsRestrict inf_le_left u).val
110	        * (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE ((inf_le_right).trans (k₂ x))).op).hom (d₂.eqn x) := by
111	        rw [show (X.unitsRestrict (inf_le_left :
112	            𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒱.opens x ≤ 𝒲.opens x) u).val
113	            = (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left :
114	                𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒱.opens x ≤ 𝒲.opens x)).op).hom u.val from rfl]
115	        exact E1
116	    _ = (X.unitsRestrict inf_le_left u).val * ((X.unitsRestrict inf_le_right v).val
117	        * (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE ((inf_le_right).trans (k₃ x))).op).hom (d₃.eqn x)) := by
118	        rw [show (X.unitsRestrict (inf_le_right :
119	            𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒱.opens x ≤ 𝒱.opens x) v).val
120	            = (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_right :
121	                𝒲.opens x ⊓ 𝒱.opens x ≤ 𝒱.opens x)).op).hom v.val from rfl]
122	        rw [E2]
123	    _ = (X.unitsRestrict inf_le_left u).val * (X.unitsRestrict inf_le_right v).val
124	        * (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE _).op).hom (d₃.eqn x) := by
125	        rw [mul_assoc]

261	    (unit : ∀ j, Γ(relCurve C R, D.pieces j)ˣ)

269	        ≤ d.cover.opens (pt j) ⊓ d.cover.opens y :=
270	      inf_le_inf (piece_le j) le_rfl

272	      (inf_le_left : D.pieces j ⊓ d.cover.opens y ≤ D.pieces j)).op).hom (eqn_eq j)

274	    have E2 := congrArg ((relCurve C R).presheaf.map (homOfLE hWle).op).hom

276	    rw [map_mul, Scheme.LocalEquations.res_res, Scheme.LocalEquations.res_res] at E2
277	    refine ⟨(relCurve C R).unitsRestrict inf_le_left (unit j)
278	      * (relCurve C R).unitsRestrict hWle (d.ratioUnit (pt j) y), ?_⟩

(`informal/spec-dd-1.md` §3 (f), the DD-1c inverse-law adjudication)

The forward map `divFamDivisor` (`AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyField`) sends a
certified divisor family over the field `K` to its Weil divisor, and is `DivEq`-invariant
(`Scheme.presentationDivisor_eq_of_divEq`). This file lands the **converse** and the
**injectivity** it powers, and packages the **equiv reduction** — the exact assembly of the
frozen `divFamFieldEquiv` from the two remaining, precisely-named gaps.

* `Scheme.divEq_of_presentationDivisor_eq` — the **converse of DivEq-invariance**: two
  local-equation systems on the curve with the *same* Weil divisor are divisor-equal. On the
  common refinement of the two covers the ratio of the anchor equations is a unit at every
  closed point (equal orders read the equal divisor coefficient off any piece,
  `MeromorphicPresentation.ordZ_elem_eq` + `coeffAt_presentationDivisor`), hence — being an
  `𝒪(0)`-section together with its inverse (`exists_section_germ_eq`) — a genuine unit
  section that rescales one system to the other. Together with the landed
  `presentationDivisor_eq_of_divEq` this is the characterization
  `DivEq d₁ d₂ ↔ presentationDivisor d₁ = presentationDivisor d₂`.

* `divFamDivisor_injective` — the **forward map is injective**: two families with equal
  divisor are `DivEq`, hence equal in the setoid `DivFam`. This is *unconditional* (no
  Mayer–Vietoris, no backward construction); it is the injective half of `divFamFieldEquiv`,
  and it *is* the second inverse law `divFamOfDivisor (divFamDivisor F) = F` once the
  backward map exists (both sides then present the same divisor).

* `divFamFieldEquivOfDegOfSurj` — the **equiv reduction**: given the two remaining gaps —
  `hdeg` (the general colength↔degree identity `deg (divFamDivisor F) = n` for an *arbitrary*
  certified family, the honest Mayer–Vietoris wall) and `hsurj` (backward realization: every
  effective degree-`n` divisor is the divisor of some certified family, discharged over `K`
  by the support-separated construction whose certificate rank is `deg = n` *for free* via
  `deg_divFamDivisor_of_separated`, no general MV) — the equiv
  `DivFam C K π n ≃ {D // 0 ≤ D ∧ deg K D = n}` drops out (injectivity is already free).

The full `divFamFieldEquiv` needs **exactly two** further inputs, and neither is the second
inverse law (that is landed here as `divFamDivisor_injective`):

1. `hdeg` — LANDED (2026-07-18, I-0230): `deg_divFamDivisor` in

   unconditionally; the glued colength is adaptation-independent

2. `hsurj` — the backward realization (a support-separated certified family per effective

   not** need general MV: its certificate's `finrank W = deg D = n` is the *separated*

`divFamDivisor_injective`) and need **not** fund the general-MV brick, provided ε (DD-4) is
mono so family equality can be tested after ε.
-/

The certificate assemblers consume, per piece `j`, the fibrewise no-leak clause, which is
emptiness of the leak locus, which is closedness of the piece trace
`supportLocus ∩ pieces j` (`isClosed_supportLocus_inter_iff_supportLeak_eq_empty`), which

**the per-piece clause cannot be produced piece by piece.**  A `FinCoverData` carries a
partition of unity on each pinned chart, so the chart-`b` pieces cover the *whole* pinned
chart `V_b` — hence the union of their traces is the whole chart trace
`supportLocus ∩ V_b`.  A finite union of closed sets is closed, so

> no-leak at every chart-`b` piece **forces** `supportLocus ∩ V_b` to be closed in the
> relative curve, i.e. the chart trace to be clopen in the support.

That is a property of the *system and the pinned charts alone*: no choice of adaptation, and
no shrinking of the base, can produce no-leak for a system whose chart trace is not closed.
It is therefore the honest gate of the lane, and it replaces the refuted `tube-fibre`
framing (put the support inside one piece — impossible once the support meets both charts,

(`DivSchemeCertZarSep.lean`) with a single geometric statement about the divisor.

closed is not merely necessary, it is *sufficient*, because the two-piece adaptation whose
pieces are the pinned charts themselves realizes it (`DivSchemeCertZarChartPair.lean`).

* `AlgebraicGeometry.DivisorAdaptation.supportLocus_inter_chart₀_eq_iUnion` /
